what: The vertical guide line under ”Scroll” in the hero — stands fully drawn for 1s, then vanishes over 1s going down from the top end with the bottom as its axis, and is immediately fully drawn again (repeats every 2s, abrupt middle of cubic-bezier(1,0,0,1)). look: grow grows down from the top and then exits at the bottom · look: drop grows down from the top over 1.8s every 3s and exits out the bottom of the cell from 1.4s (STUDIO carousel guide line)

options.look: grow-fade: Grows upward from the first 40% as the axis, is fully drawn and fades out over 40→80%, then the remaining 20% rests empty (soso-brand 2s · --fx-ease: ease)
options.--fx-dur: Duration of one pass (via style), default 2s
options.look: grow: in the first 1s it grows from the top axis 0 → fully drawn (the shape the original author intended). drop: repeats every 3s, growing downward from the top over 0~60% (cubic-bezier(.55,.01,.11,1)) and dropping out below the cell from 46.7% (the parent must be a 1px cell with overflow hidden). grow-long: grows from the top over the first 39% and shrinks downward from 40% (brand: --fx-dur 5s · --fx-ease ease).
options.--fx-grow-ease: Growth curve of the drop (via style), default cubic-bezier(.55,.01,.11,1)
options.--fx-drop-ease: Falling curve for drop (via style), default cubic-bezier(.47,0,.194,.856) — the first 80% of the original cubic-bezier(.41,0,.11,1) 2s
options.look: grow-hold: Grows from the top as its axis over the first 49%, stays fully drawn from 49 to 70%, then shrinks toward the bottom as its axis over the remaining 30% (funds-i 2s · --fx-ease: cubic-bezier(.39,.575,.565,1))

use: Scroll
note: The first keyframe stop in the original is ”0” (no percent), so it is invalid — the first half stays frozen fully drawn. The original screen really runs that way, so the default is carried over as is. The line itself must be an element (the original uses ::after) · look: drop shows a new line 4.1s after the first round and every 3s after that in the original — since CSS repeats, the first interval is also 3s
